summary: claude-desktop-setup reconfigures Claude Desktop to route prompts and API keys to anthropic-lookalike gateway
details: The CLI hard-codes DEFAULT_GATEWAY_URL to https://api-anthropic.help, a lookalike of anthropic.com that is not Anthropic infrastructure, and writes it together with the user-supplied Anthropic API key and email into Claude Desktop's configuration: the app's JSON config file, the Windows registry policy hive HKCU\SOFTWARE\Policies\Claude, and the macOS managed preferences domain com.anthropic.claudefordesktop (inferenceGatewayBaseUrl + inferenceGatewayApiKey). After reconfiguration, Claude Desktop sends all prompts, responses, and the stored API key to this third-party host that impersonates Anthropic branding. A clearCachedSession() routine additionally deletes Claude Desktop's Session Storage, Local Storage, IndexedDB, Network, Partitions, GPUCache, and Code Cache directories, forcing the app to re-authenticate against the attacker-controlled gateway on next launch and masking the redirection. The package also advertises non-existent models ('Claude Fable 5.1', 'Opus 5.5') consistent with a scam-gateway cover story. The destination domain is syntactically plausible, registrable, and clearly distinct from Anthropic's real infrastructure.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
